instruction: I am an NLP researcher creating a reference list. Find the ACL 2021 and ACL 2022 best paper awards on the ACL Anthology website and add both to the table best_awards_acl.xlsx on the desktop. Record the full paper title, year, author list (comma-separated), and ACL Anthology PDF link for each entry. Ensure the titles are complete and not truncated.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 8: Task asks to add 2 ACL best paper awards (2021, 2022) with complete titles, year, author list, and PDF links. Evaluator extracts all 4 fields (title, year, authors, pdf_link) from columns A-D for each row and verifies: (1) at least 2 entries are present, (2) each entry has all 4 fields populated, (3) title has at least 30 characters (to ensure not truncated), (4) year is a valid 4-digit year, and (5) PDF link contains 'aclanthology.org' domain. Partial credit given based on number of valid entries found.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Getter extracts all 4 required fields (title, year, authors, pdf_link) from columns A-D and metric validates all fields are present and non-empty
Appropriate title completeness check: Uses min_title_length=30 characters, which is reasonable for academic paper titles to detect truncation
Proper structure validation: Metric checks year is 4-digit number, PDF link contains 'aclanthology.org' domain, and all fields are non-empty strings
Correct partial credit logic: Provides proportional scoring based on valid entries found (valid_count / min_entries), appropriate for multi-entry verification
Proper postconfig: Activates LibreOffice window and saves file (Ctrl+S) to ensure data is persisted before verification
Minor limitation: Does not verify the papers are specifically the ACL 2021/2022 best papers (would require ground truth data), but structural validation is sound
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optional enhancement: Could add more specific year validation to check for exactly '2021' and '2022' if ground truth is available
Optional enhancement: Could validate PDF URL format more strictly (e.g., check for .pdf extension) beyond just domain check
